map.15% → 品牌利润 = 750 万；份额系数 min(10/10,5)=1；品: 15% -> brand profit = 7.5 million; share coefficient min(10/10,5)=1; brand value = 7.5 x multiplier 5 x age 1.2 x 1 = 45 million (about 0.45 billion), in the regional-brand tier.
map.消费品乘数 8、科技 10、金工 5、制造 4：同利润 750 万，科技品牌价值: Consumer goods multiplier 8, tech 10, metalworking 5, manufacturing 4: at the same 7.5 million profit, a tech brand value reaches 7.5 x 10 x 1.2 = 90 million, far above the manufacturing tier 4.
map.常用收益法：品牌利润×行业乘数×年限系数×份额系数；乘数与行业、品牌强度相关，仅: The common income approach: brand profit x industry multiplier x age coefficient x share coefficient; the multiplier relates to industry and brand strength and is only a reference estimate.
map.市场份额系数为何封顶 5？: Why is the market-share coefficient capped at 5?
map.份额对溢价有边际递减，min(份额/10, 5) 避免垄断份额过度放大估值，使模: Share has diminishing marginal effect on premium; min(share/10, 5) prevents a monopoly share from over-inflating the value, stabilizing the model.
map.品牌价值评估计算工具，基于收益法，输入年营收、品牌利润率、行业品牌乘数、品牌年限: Brand value evaluation calculator: based on the income approach, it inputs annual revenue, brand profit margin, industry brand multiplier, brand age coefficient and market share to compute a brand-value estimate.
